story_structure.name: Kishotenketsu
story_structure.core_movement: A precise Thursday cleaning routine is introduced and developed until an unexpected paper fish reframes the tower's glass, labor, river, and play into one reconciled image.
story_structure.adaptation_summary: The rehearsal adapts Ki/Sho/Ten/Ketsu into four Beat Plan beats: introduction, development, turn, and reconciliation. It preserves movement through pattern and recontextualization rather than conflict escalation.
story_structure.turn_logic: The audience first learns the cleaner's careful routine, then sees the paper fish reframe the work from maintenance into a way the building can briefly imagine water.
story_structure.compression_rule: Give each part one clear move: establish routine, deepen the reflective pattern, introduce the fish as turn, and let the final reflections reconcile the parts.
story_structure.expansion_rule: If expanded, repeat Thursday cleaning details across sections or floors before introducing a turn that recontextualizes the whole pattern without requiring an antagonist.
failure_modes: the turn is treated as random whimsy and does not reframe the first parts
the structure is mistaken for nothing happening
conflict is forced into a piece that needs contrast instead
reconciliation explains the metaphor instead of letting the image click

beats.one_move_summary: Before sunrise, the cleaner begins his Thursday route through the office tower's glass.
beats.before_state: The building is dark, empty, and marked by ordinary traces.
beats.after_state: The cleaner's routine gives the tower a cared-for rhythm before anyone arrives.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: Window cleaning may read as repetitive background labor.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The routine becomes intimate because the cleaner knows the city through reflections.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The opening asks the audience to treat maintenance as perception.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Solitude carries care rather than emptiness.

beats.intended_feeling: quiet respect for precise unseen work
beats.emotional_payload: The world begins as routine attention.
source_evidence: The reference begins with a window cleaner visiting the same office tower before sunrise.

pivot_options.label: deepen-pattern
pivot_options.next_move: Develop the route through repeated panes, marks, and reflections.
pivot_options.rationale: Kishotenketsu needs the audience to learn the pattern before the turn can reframe it.

traceability_notes.note: The Ki beat introduces the tower, Thursday route, and cared-for routine.

beats.one_move_summary: Floor by floor, the cleaner removes fingerprints, coffee steam, and weather marks while reading the city as layered reflection.
beats.before_state: The routine is established as one act of care.
beats.after_state: The pattern deepens into a way of seeing: glass holds work, weather, and city together.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: Development might escalate toward a work problem or interruption.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The beat deepens the existing pattern without forcing conflict.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The audience learns how the work sees before the turn arrives.

beats.intended_feeling: calm absorption in a pattern becoming legible
beats.emotional_payload: The route teaches the audience how to look through glass and reflection.

tension_profile.name: Repetition / Discovery
tension_profile.emotional_function: lets repeated labor gather new detail

tension_profile.name: Inside / Outside
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps office interiors and city reflections layered together

source_evidence: The cleaner wipes fingerprints, coffee steam, and weather marks and knows the city through reflections.

pivot_options.label: introduce-turn
pivot_options.next_move: Place the paper fish in the conference room window.
pivot_options.rationale: The pattern is now clear enough for one unexpected image to reframe it.

traceability_notes.note: The Sho beat protects routine labor as meaningful rather than empty.

beats.one_move_summary: The cleaner finds a child's paper fish taped inside a conference room window, facing outward toward the river.
beats.before_state: The glass has been a surface of labor, city, and office traces.
beats.after_state: The paper fish makes the glass feel like a possible membrane between tower and river.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: A corporate conference room should continue the established office pattern.
expectation_turn.actual_result: A child's fish faces outward, introducing play and river logic into the tower.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The Ten turn changes the frame without creating an enemy or crisis.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: The quiet routine is pierced by delight and slight ache.

beats.intended_feeling: small wonder at an image that should not fit but does
beats.emotional_payload: The turn reveals that play was possible inside the routine all along.

tension_profile.name: Glass / Water
tension_profile.emotional_function: lets the fish reframe the building through river logic

source_evidence: A child's paper fish is taped inside a conference room window, facing outward toward the river.

pivot_options.label: reconcile
pivot_options.next_move: Let the fish's reflection travel through the cleaned panes.
pivot_options.rationale: Ketsu should connect the turn back to the whole route.

traceability_notes.note: The Ten beat introduces contrast that changes the frame without requiring confrontation.

beats.one_move_summary: By the end of the route, every cleaned pane briefly catches the fish's reflection and the tower seems full of water.
beats.before_state: The fish appears as one odd image inside one room.
beats.after_state: The entire cleaned route is reconciled as a hidden river of reflected play.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: The fish might remain a quirky interruption.
expectation_turn.actual_result: Its reflection connects the tower, river, glass, labor, and play.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The ending lets the whole prior routine click into a new pattern.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Completion feels light without erasing the solitude of the work.

beats.intended_feeling: gentle recognition that the work has been carrying a hidden shimmer
beats.emotional_payload: The routine is not escaped; it is newly visible.

tension_profile.name: Labor / Play
tension_profile.emotional_function: reconciles the cleaner's work with the child's image

tension_profile.name: Explanation / Click
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps the ending image-based rather than over-explained

source_evidence: Every cleaned pane briefly catches the fish's reflection, making the tower look like it is full of water.

traceability_notes.note: The Ketsu beat preserves hidden play changing the labor pattern without defeating the work.

tension_points.summary: One playful image changes the meaning of a precise labor pattern without creating conflict.
tension_points.emotional_payload: The tower becomes briefly waterlike because the work made it clean enough to reflect play.
source_evidence: The paper fish's reflection appears across the cleaned panes.

traceability_notes.note: The tension point protects contrast and reconciliation without forced conflict.

tension_movement_plan.contrast_goal: Teach the audience the cleaning pattern, introduce a contrast that reframes it, and reconcile the parts without forcing conflict escalation.

minimum_tension_criteria.waiver_rule: A lower adjacent shift can be waived only if the artist explicitly wants a more meditative piece and the Ten turn still changes the frame.

adjacent_beat_shifts.shift_summary: The routine deepens from one cared-for action into a legible reflective pattern.
The established office-glass pattern is reframed by a child's paper fish and river-facing play.
The fish stops being a single odd object and reconciles the whole route as waterlike reflection.

tension_movement_plan.reviewer_instruction: Block if the plan forces an antagonist or victory/defeat arc, if the Ten turn feels arbitrary, or if Ketsu explains the image instead of reconciling it through felt perception.

arc_summary.beginning: A window cleaner's precise Thursday route introduces unseen labor as care.
arc_summary.turn: A child's paper fish in a conference room window reframes the tower's glass through river and play.
arc_summary.ending_or_residue: The cleaned panes catch the fish's reflection so the whole building briefly seems full of water.
arc_summary.scale_rationale: A four-beat arc is necessary because the structure needs introduction, development, turn, and reconciliation rather than conflict escalation.

traceability_summary.note: The Beat Plan adapts the invented reference's Thursday cleaning route, paper fish turn, and final reflection reconciliation.
The adapted Kishotenketsu preserves hidden play re-seeing routine labor without forcing conflict.
Kishotenketsu guides Ki/Sho/Ten/Ketsu movement without choosing medium, output shape, asset count, or Cultural Format Structure.
